correction.old_export_behavior: The exporter passed all four serialized float4 rows as a homogeneous 4x4 node matrix.
correction.problem: The fourth serialized row is not a homogeneous transform row. Writing it into glTF creates a projective/non-affine Blender node matrix.
correction.correct_affine_transform: +0x00..+0x2F: first three float4 rows form the 3x4 affine SRT transform; synthesize homogeneous row [0,0,0,1].
correction.per_instance_uv: +0x30 float scale, +0x34 float translateX, +0x38 float translateY.
correction.tail_0x3c: not treated as a transform element; semantic still intentionally unnamed.

observations: Translation is read from SRT[0][3], SRT[1][3], SRT[2][3].
Scale/rotation are derived only from the first three rows/columns.
Three floats at byte offsets 0x30,0x34,0x38 are stored separately as UVTransform.

blender_axis_adapter.policy: export adapter only; canonical source matrices remain D1-space 3x4 affine records
